supplemental.oracle: Pinned GGML CPU objects from the imported portable oracle with contraction disabled.
supplemental.views: Run all six shapes on ordinary and transposed one-word offset views with half-pixel or aligned corners, each with two input distributions.
supplemental.input: For backing index i use (((13*i+11)%41)-20)/2^(i%6). In the exceptional distribution replace i%37=0 with negative infinity, otherwise i%31=0 with negative zero, otherwise i%29=0 with a quiet NaN.
supplemental.broadcast: Four inputs [(1<<k)+14,3,1,1] for k in {31,40,49,56} use zero X stride and source words [0x80000000,0x40400000,0x3f200000]. The output shape is [7,5,1,1].
supplemental.refusals: Surplus source and invalid flag words 255, 512 and 768 refuse admission and graph execution and preserve all output bytes.

native_fma.oracle: Same pinned GGML CPU source compiled with x86 FMA enabled.
